Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real. We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world. Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth. Why This Role Exists As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet. job.title: Strategy & Operations Coach APAC
job.jdText: About The Role We are looking for senior leaders in strategy & operations roles who value learning, growth, and community and who are passionate about developing and coaching people in their field. We are specifically looking for coaches who have experience in Singapore or Hong Kong serving the SEA region, or experience in market including Japan, India, South Korea, and Australia. As a Mento coach, you will form 1:1 partnerships with our members to help them identify & track clear goals, become a better leader, communicate more effectively, problem solve issues at work, and help them feel happy, fulfilled, and engaged at work and beyond. All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey! Your routine responsibilities will include: Providing 1:1 coaching to Mento members through virtual sessions using the Mento Platform and Tools Participating in ongoing training sessions to improve coaching abilities and skills Communicating with members via your Mento email or via chat in the Mento App in between sessions Being an integral member of the Mento coaching community by sharing coaching tools and insights â helping enhance our coaching practices and fulfill our mission of empowering people to thrive in jobs that they love Acting with kindness, respect, and empathy as an ambassador of the Mento community Who are you? You areâ¦ A director, vice president, or other senior strategy & operations leader with 20+ years experience managing strategy & ops teams and coaching individuals (coaching certification is a plus but not required). Someone who wants to turn their people leadership skills into meaningful coaching skills. Passionate about helping people advance in the workplace to build fulfilling careers and lives. A person who is self aware, who has a high emotional IQ, and who cares about creating a safe space for others to risk being vulnerable. Excited about growing your coaching skills, and you bring a growth-mindset to the experience, regardless of how long you have been a coach. Comfortable working in a constantly-changing startup environment. Able to dedicate a minimum of 12+ hours per month to coaching at Mento for the next 24+ months. At Mento, we invite new coaches to join us on a rolling basis. The time frame on which we add new coaches is based on the particular needs of our clients and their teams. While we may not need to add an Operations & Strategy VP Coach today, we would still be very excited for you to get in touch with us now if this opportunity resonates with you. Other details This is a contract position in which coaches are paid per hour. On top of a flat hourly rate, we offer select bonuses that incentivizes engagement with our membership and community growth on our platform You must have the capacity to give a minimum of three to five hours per week towards Mento regardless of other commitments and how they may change. You are able to work with Mento for a minimum of 24 months in order to build meaningful relationships with our members. This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be based in North America or Europe. Because this is a part-time growth opportunity, we are looking to hire experienced senior leaders who want to expand their coaching skills. Our Hiring Philosophy: All new Mento coaches are required to participate and graduate from our ICF certified coach training program: Mento Coaching 101. This training is rigorous, and our goal is that all participants are able to be matched with members soon after they complete it. We want to make sure that we are both setting our coaches up for success and respecting everyoneâs time. Therefore, we hire based on incoming member demand. While we are constantly looking and interviewing for the best coaches to join our team, we will only send offers to candidates for whom we have an immediate need. Candidates who receive a YES from Mento after the interview process will either be sent an offer to join the next monthly Coaching 101 training or be added to our coach shortlist to join us when the demand is there. Inclusion Statement: We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Research shows that candidates from unrepresented backgrounds may not apply to jobs unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the requirements. As Partnership Operations Manager, you will own that path for our regional partnership leads so they can focus on finding and signing partners. This is a new function, so you will set the standards and tooling yourself and make them repeatable across regions. job.jdText: ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET About Claims AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query. We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against. The team Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer. Philipp Koellinger , CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban. Christian Roessler , co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work. Ogban Ugot , engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day. You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer. Our culture We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust. About the role Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack) Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time. Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027. We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation. This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain. You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas. Responsibilities Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows. Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks. Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results. Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs. Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks. Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage. Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation. Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review. Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software. Required skills and experience Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software. Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests. Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling. Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework. Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries. Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures. Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration. An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data. The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes. Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear. Nice to have Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools. Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost. Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance. Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking. You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software. job.jdText: We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaidâs network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam. Role Overview You will be a key contributor to Accounting Operations and own the accounting for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity, and cost allocations. This includes preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciling accounts, analyzing balances and trends, and ensuring these areas are complete and accurate each month, quarter, and year-end. You will be the point of contact for your areas during the close and the annual audit. Over time, your responsibilities may expand into other areas of the close as the business and team grow. You will also help build scalable, efficient processes that support Plaidâs growth and public readiness. This includes documenting and strengthening controls in your areas, shortening the close, improving the quality and consistency of supporting documentation, and identifying opportunities to automate manual work. You will partner with the broader Accounting team, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and external auditors along the way. Responsibilities Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity and cost allocations, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analysis. Prepare and maintain intercompany and consolidation entries across Plaidâs entities, including cost-plus arrangements and FX revaluation and elimination. Partner with FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and vendors to ensure spend is accrued completely and accurately and that balances are well understood. Identify and implement process, automation, and control improvements in your areas to shorten the close and support SOX 404 readiness. Serve as the primary contact for your areas during the annual audit, preparing support and responding to auditor requests. Qualifications 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Big 4 public accounting, with a deep understanding of US GAAP; CPA preferred. Experience at a public company or with IPO readiness Familiarity with SOX compliance and the ability to produce audit-ready workpapers; Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency accounting; Proficiency with NetSuite, Zip, T&E and close management platforms is a plus Problem solver and first-principles thinker with a bias for action, creativity, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches. Curious, fast learner with a growth mindset who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Hands-on, can-do attitude , willing to roll up their sleeves, dive into details, and own execution. Proven change agent with a track record of improving processes, leveraging technology, and scaling operations. Strong communicator and collaborator who can effectively engage technical and non-technical stakeholders. Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. job.title: Country Manager Canada
job.jdText: Hello. Weâre Polaroid. An iconic brand, built by passionate people Polaroid was founded in 1937 by one of the 20th centuryâs most influential innovators, Edwin Land, whose philosophy was: âDonât undertake a project unless it is manifestly important and nearly impossible.â In 2008, Polaroid produced its last pack of instant film. But a group of passionate fans refused to let instant photography disappear. What started as The Impossible Project grew into a mission to preserve and reinvent analogue photography for a new generation. More than a decade later, that same startup acquired the Polaroid brand and continues to shape its future today. At Polaroid, we create products and experiences that spark emotion, fuel creativity, and bring people closer together. At the intersection of art and technology, we believe in the power of analogue moments and genuine human connection in an increasingly digital world. The Role As the Country Manager, Canada - you will play a pivotal role in managing and expanding our footprint with National Retailers and Independents alike. We are looking for an experienced account manager that has excellent business and execution skills to deliver profitable customer plans and market share growth. In addition to channel and operational management responsibilities, this role will also collaborate with internal stakeholders from sales operations, finance, demand planning, product management, and marketing. Key Responsibilities: Canada Market Leadership: Serve as the commercial lead for Polaroid in Canada, owning the Canadian wholesale plan and accountability for revenue and market growth. Be the in-market face of the business and the primary point of leadership for the Canadian commercial team and stakeholders. National Account Ownership: Act as the strategic lead for all national wholesale accounts, ensuring long-term scalability, commercial profitability, and a premium Polaroid brand presence across every brick-and-mortar and digital retail touchpoint. Account Partnership: Build and hold trusted relationships with the most senior buyers, merchants, and decision-makers across national accounts. Lead joint business planning and negotiate mutually beneficial terms that create sustainable, multi-year growth. Team & Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead and coordinate the Canadian commercial plan, including setting priorities and coaching supporting team members. Partner closely with US-based planning, finance, retail marketing, and product teams. Forecasting, Demand Planning & SKU Transition: Translate market data into actionable inventory strategies. Lead seasonal forecasting and rolling monthly projections and manage SKU EOL transitions to protect sell-through. Track consumer trends and identify opportunities to capitalize or course-correct. Sell-Through & Brand Activation: Shift the focus from sell-in to sell-through. Partner with retail marketing and activation teams to execute high-impact programs, elevate in-store positioning and shelf execution, and consistently use retail assets to drive account performance. Brand Ambassador & Product Evangelism: Act as the face of Polaroid by demonstrating our world-class products at trade shows, training events, and major national account meetings. What You'll Need to Succeed Experience: Demonstrable progressive, high-impact sales and account management experience within a consumer goods, consumer electronics, or premium hardware retail environment, including experience leading a market, a team, or a portfolio with meaningful autonomy. A proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar national retail portfolios is essential. Canadian Retailer Depth: Deep familiarity with the Canadian retail landscape and established senior-level relationships across major national chains. Commercial & Analytical Literacy: Strong command of retail math, inventory pipelines, pricing elasticity, and promotional mechanics. Comfortable evaluating complex financial models and partnering closely with finance and operations leaders. Strategic Influence: Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a proven track record of influencing external executive leadership and aligning internal cross-functional teams around a shared growth vision. Self-Directed Leadership: Able to operate as the senior Polaroid presence in-market: setting direction and making decisions while staying tightly connected to the North American strategy. AI in our hiring process Our recruitment team reviews every application, including your CV. We may use AI-assisted technology to support the initial review process and help our recruiters work more efficiently. Your application is always reviewed by a recruiter and all our hiring decisions are made by people. Learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.polaroid.com/legal/careers-job-applicant-privacy-policy Â Our Approach to AI At Polaroid we believe two things can be true at once: technology can help us move forward, while human creativity, craft, judgement and real-world connection matter more than ever. Since our beginning, we've embraced technology to create meaningful human experiences. Today that means exploring new tools, including AI, with curiosity and care, using them where they help us work better and build a stronger business, while staying true to what defines our brand.
